title: Online Retailer CDJapan Confirms Potential Customer Information Leaks Caused by Unauthorized Access
content: Between November 6 at 9:06 p.m. and November 13 at 7:52 p.m. JST, the company noted that a third party had tampered with the credit card information entry page, and there were scripts designed to steal information.
author: ANN

title: Avatar: Seven Havens Isn’t Seen as a “Kids Show,” Producers Explain
content: Avatar: Seven Havens might be approachable for younger audiences and fans of all ages, but those behind the series don’t really see it as just a show for kids. Avatar: The Last Airbender originally kicked off the franchise with Nickelodeon decades ago, and with it introduced animation fans to a whole new kind of world…
author: ComicBook

title: Singer/Songwriter Hiromi Ōta Dies at 71
content: There was a funeral service for close family. Ōta was born on January 20, 1955 in Tokyo and grew up in Kasukabe, Saitama Prefecture. She made her career debut with the song "Amadare" (Raindrops) in 1974. She was diagnosed with breast cancer in 2019. She was hospitalized for treatment in 2024.
author: ANN

title: One Piece’s New Movie Could Change the Anime Forever
content: One Piece has been airing for more than 25 years, and over its long run, it has become a part of many fans’ lives. However, it could change forever with a new One Piece movie releasing next year.
author: ComicBook

title: Miss Konosuba? You Need to Watch Crunchyroll’s Funniest Fall Anime
content: If you’re missing Konosuba: God’s Blessing on this Wonderful World right now, there’s a new anime now streaming with Crunchyroll this Fall that you really should give a chance. Konosuba has become a standout anime franchise because of the parodical take on Isekai stories .
author: ComicBook

title: Sumikko Gurashi Franchise's New Switch 2 Game Launches on November 19
content: A new game in the Sumikko Gurashi franchise titled Sumikkogurashi Welcome to Poka Poka Onsen ( Sumikko Gurashi Pokapoka Onsen ni Yо̄koso ) launches on Thursday for Nintendo Switch 2. In the game, players run a hot spring with the Sumikko. There are furniture, decorations, outfits, collectibles, and minigames.
author: ANN

title: Dragon Ball Super’s Manga Deserves to Return From Hiatus to End Its Story
content: Dragon Ball Super has been on an indefinite hiatus for the past two years, and the manga deserves to get a proper grand finale with a return for at least one more arc so fans can say goodbye. Dragon Ball Super is in such a strange place right now when it comes to the franchise on a whole.
author: ComicBook

title: Solo Leveling Drops New Look At Jinwoo’s Most Powerful Shadows Ahead of New Movie
content: While Solo Leveling has yet to share more updates on its anticipated movie, the official X handle drops a new look at Jinwoo’s shadows. The second season wrapped up in March last year, and since then, fans have been anticipating the release window and even a trailer for the movie.
author: ComicBook

title: New Lilo & Stitch Animated Revival Reveals Sneak Peek Clip Ahead of Release in Theaters
content: Lilo & Stitch is coming to theaters with an animated revival bringing back the classic franchise for a new generation, and a new sneak peek is showing off the first look at its new short in motion.
author: ComicBook

title: Inklore to Release Tomoko Yamashita's Ikoku Nikki Manga on June 8
content: Inklore revealed on Wednesday the cover art and June 8, 2027 release for the first volume of Tomoko Yamashita 's Ikoku Nikki manga. The company will release the manga under the English title Ikoku Nikki : Diary of a Strange Land .
author: ANN
